items.brief:
Build a bounded, honest bundle read, one place for bundle words, and safe bundle writes (create, edit, slug).

1. New pure lib/commerce/bundle-compat.js: compatFrom({ items, bundle_price, variantsById, productsById }) -> { ok, state, reasons, problems, components, componentsSum, saving, liveSaving }.
   - state: available, sold_out, no_saving or not_ready. Order: not_ready (fewer than 2 components, a duplicate variantId, a bad price, mixed currencies), then sold_out (a component variant or product unavailable, or missing from the catalog), then no_saving.
   - reasons: structured [{ kind: 'too_few'|'duplicate'|'bad_price'|'mixed_currency'|'sold_out'|'missing'|'no_saving', index?, title?, sum?, price? }]. New UI words come only from reasons, never from problems.
   - problems: the legacy strings, byte for byte (they carry ₹ and 'component N:'; only the getBundle snapshot and legacy callers use them). A duplicate variantId adds a new legacy-style problem only for rows that have one (none in the snapshot).
   - saving: legacy value Math.max(0, sum - price) as today (getBundle snapshot unchanged). liveSaving: sum > 0 && price > 0 ? Math.round(Math.max(0, sum - price)) : 0, which equals the engine's BUNDLE discount for one set.
   lib/bundles.js checkBundleCompatibility calls it and keeps its output shape byte for byte (test-effective-read snapshot).
2. New pure lib/commerce/bundle-words.js: the ONLY source of bundle-state wording. stateLine(state, reasons, { currency, formatMoney }) and reasonSentence(reason, …) give the final sentences (plan section 1.9 lists them). Money uses formatMoney(amount, currency). No ₹, no 'INR', no 'component N:'. Used by P5-BLOCKS, P5-CHECKS, P5-PANEL and P5-EDITOR.
3. New edge-safe lib/commerce/bundle-read.js, importing only lib/db.js, lib/catalog/effective.js, bundle-compat.js (never lib/offers, never node:). bundlesByIds(ids) -> Map id -> { id, slug, title, description, bundle_price, currency, componentsSum, saving (= liveSaving), state, reasons, overlapsWith:[{ id, title }], components:[{ variantId, quantity, title, image, available, state: 'ok'|'sold_out'|'missing' }] }.
   - state: available, sold_out, no_saving, not_ready, disabled, missing.
   - Statement 1: bundles b LEFT JOIN offers o ON o.id = 'bundle-' || b.id WHERE b.id IN (ids) OR b.enabled = 1. From it: the requested rows; not_ready when the bundle is enabled but its offer row is missing, disabled, scheduled out (starts_at/ends_at), or its config price or item set differs from the bundle row (read the config shape from lib/offers/store.js rowToOffer by reading the code, do not import it); overlapsWith = other enabled bundles sharing any variantId (the engine gives every BUNDLE offer priority 5 and no order, so overlap can change the cart saving).
   - Statement 2: variants WHERE id IN (every component variant id). Statement 3: effective byIds (every product id). currency: the variants' currency, falling back to the product's; mixed -> not_ready (mixed_currency); none -> null. Every caller formats with formatMoney(amount, currency ?? undefined): formatMoney's 'INR' default applies only to undefined, and null gives 'null 1500.00'.
   - At most 3 statements for any number of bundles, excluding lib/schema-compat.js hasColumns probes (warm them before counting in tests).
   - A database fault throws; never folded into missing or an empty Map. Payloads carry effective titles only, never catalog_title or sku.
4. lib/bundles.js writes:
   - Items are normalised on every write: duplicate variantIds are merged into one entry with the summed quantity (so a new bundle can never get the engine's per-entry double discount).
   - upsertBundle(id = null) with a slug that exists throws SLUG_TAKEN ('A bundle with this link already exists.'), never overwrites. An edit whose slug hits UNIQUE(slug) also throws SLUG_TAKEN (map the constraint error), not a database 5xx.
   - upsertBundle on edit (id given) keeps the stored slug, description and enabled state when those fields are undefined. An edit of an ENABLED bundle whose new items or price fail compat is refused (BUNDLE_INCOMPATIBLE with reasons), with no row or offer change; it is never turned off silently. enable: false still turns it off; enable: true is compat-gated as today.
   - createBundle({ title, items, bundle_price, description?, enable, mustPass }) derives the slug: lowercase ASCII, non-alphanumerics to '-', trimmed; empty -> 'bundle'; the base is cut so base + suffix ≤ 61 characters (the slug rule /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,60}$/); adds -2, -3 … until free, and retries on a UNIQUE violation (race). mustPass: true refuses (BUNDLE_INCOMPATIBLE, reasons) and saves nothing when compat fails; otherwise it saves turned off and returns the reasons.
   - Check scripts/test-commerce-exp.js lines ~105-108 still pass (the first upsert of slug 'broken' throws 'can't enable' before any write, so the second is a fresh create and needs no change; keep the 'can't enable' prefix in that legacy error) and scripts/perf-fixture.js (look the id up by slug before upsertBundle, so a reseed onto a non-fresh DB does not throw).
5. app/api/admin/bundles/route.js (alias hooks needed in tests, see 7):
   - POST { create: { title, items:[{ variantId gid, quantity }], bundle_price, description?, enable?, mustPass? } } (offers.write): items must be variant GIDs (a handle is refused 422 'Pick the product again.'); calls createBundle; same audit line; returns { bundle, compat: { state, reasons }, currency }.
   - The existing `bundle` action passes enable through only when sent (`'enable' in b ? !!b.enable : undefined`) so edits keep enabled; description likewise. SLUG_TAKEN and BUNDLE_INCOMPATIBLE map to 409 / 422 with the plain message, never 5xx.
   - GET and POST { check } add currency (storeCurrency from lib/offers/catalog: a console route, not a block) and structured reasons. Handle resolution in resolveItems is left for P5-PANEL.
6. lib/admin/refs.js handleRefsGet: type=bundle under storefront.read (OQ-A). Rows { id, slug, title, state, reasons, enabled, bundle_price, saving, currency, componentCount, overlapsWith }, ids= hydrate (in the given order), q= title search (LIKE, limit), read through bundlesByIds (q= first selects matching ids, one extra statement).
7. Tests:
   - scripts/test-commerce-exp.js gains the registerHooks '@/' alias block and next/server shim copied from scripts/test-cms-api.js so it can call the route handler.
   - State matrix on a tenant-fixture file DB: available, sold_out, no_saving, not_ready (offer row deleted; offer disabled; offer price changed; duplicate items written raw), disabled, missing.
   - Statement count (warm probe first): equal for 1 bundle of 2 components and 6 bundles of 4, and at most 3.
   - A rejected bundles read throws.
   - liveSaving equals the BUNDLE discount getCart (lib/cart.js) gives for one complete set; with a bundle whose items were [{v1,1},{v1,1}], the write merges to [{v1,2}] and the engine discount equals the advertised saving.
   - Overlap: A={v1,v2} and B={v1,v2,v3} both enabled -> each lists the other in overlapsWith.
   - Slugs: SLUG_TAKEN on create and on edit; 'Gym Kit' twice -> gym-kit, gym-kit-2; a 61-character title -> the -2 slug passes the rule; a Hindi-only title -> 'bundle'; mustPass with a failing compat saves nothing.
   - Edits: editing an enabled bundle's price (no enable, no description sent) leaves it enabled, its offer enabled with the new price, and the description kept; an edit that breaks compat on an enabled bundle gives 422 and no row or offer change.
   - Route: POST { create } with a handle -> 422 'Pick the product again.', no row.
   - Import scan: bundle-read.js, bundle-compat.js and bundle-words.js import nothing under lib/offers/ and no node: module (transitively for bundle-read: lib/db.js, tenant-context, schema-compat, effective.js).
   - scripts/test-refs.js: type=bundle rows with state; ids= hydrate; q= search; a session without storefront.read gets 403.

name: Batch 3: editor bundle picker and inline create

items.brief:
Let the founder pick or create a bundle from the inspector, and tell them each bundle's state in plain words.

1. New controls BundleControl (single) and BundleListControl (ordered list: add, remove, move), registered in components/admin/editor/fields/controls.js CONTROLS and inspectorModel.js CONTROL_OF_KIND (bundle -> 'bundle', bundle_list -> 'bundle_list'):
   - a search field (refs q=) over the bundle list from editor context; each option shows title, price (formatMoney with its currency) and a state chip;
   - picking writes { id } only (re-picking replaces any old value, including an invalid { id, title } one);
   - EVERY picked bundle (the single one, and each row of the list) shows its chip and the bundle-words status line: available 'Showing to shoppers'; disabled 'Turned off: shoppers don't see this section. Turn it on in Catalog > Bundles.'; sold_out 'A product in this bundle is sold out: shoppers see Currently unavailable and can't add it.'; no_saving 'The price no longer saves anything (the products add up to <sum>): shoppers can't add it. Lower the price in Catalog > Bundles.'; not_ready 'This bundle isn't ready for the cart yet: shoppers can't add it. Open it in Catalog > Bundles and save it again.'; missing 'This bundle was deleted. Pick another or remove it.'; plus, when overlapsWith is not empty, 'Another bundle uses the same products, so the cart may give a different saving.' Each 'Catalog > Bundles' is a link to /admin/catalog#bundles (new tab).
   - BundleListControl refuses a duplicate pick with 'This bundle is already in the grid.' and keeps the order;
   - anchorsOf entries so validation issues (incomplete, UNKNOWN_FIELD, INVALID_VALUE on an index) land on the control or row.
2. components/admin/editor/DocumentEditor.js: load bundles once at mount alongside products and collections (fetchRefs({ type: 'bundle', limit: 50 }) plus ids= hydrate for picked ids not in the first page; search goes to q=). Refresh on window focus and after an inline create, so the chips match the preview. A failed or 403 read shows 'You can't see bundles here.'; a picked bundle then shows its id with that sentence and can still be removed (not replaced).
3. Inline create: a 'Create a bundle' button opens a Dialog with BundleForm compact (P5-PANEL). The Dialog says: 'The bundle is saved and turned on now: its discount works in the cart and its page /bundles/<slug> opens right away, even if you don't publish. It shows on your home page after you publish.' Save stays disabled until the live check passes (no failed bundle is ever saved, so retries never make gym-kit-2, gym-kit-3). On save it picks the new id and refreshes context. The button is hidden, with 'Ask an owner to create bundles.', when the session lacks offers.write: app/(console)/admin/(authed)/editor/page.js passes a can={{ offersWrite }} prop to DocumentEditor (OQ-A).
4. BundleForm.js may get small compact-mode fixes here (P5-PANEL has merged).
5. Tests:
   - scripts/test-editor-inspector.js: remove bundle and bundle_list from WAITING_KINDS; inspectorCoverage() has no bundle or bundle_list problem (other waiting kinds stay); status line per state (available, sold_out, no_saving, not_ready, disabled, missing, overlap, can't-see); a pick writes exactly { id }; re-picking over { id, title } writes { id } and validateDocument then has no UNKNOWN_FIELD for it; BundleListControl keeps order and refuses a duplicate; anchorsOf maps incomplete, UNKNOWN_FIELD and an indexed INVALID_VALUE.
   - scripts/test-bundle-form.js: the inline-create Dialog renders only Name, Products and Price, the 'turned on now … even if you don't publish' sentence, and Save disabled while the check fails; the 'Create a bundle' button is absent without offers.write.

No legacy impact: the editor only opens on documents stores.

Owner answers (2026-11-05): OQ-B is answered AGAINST the default: a bundle whose price no longer saves anything (no_saving) is HIDDEN for shoppers, like disabled: the card is hidden and a grid drops its cell; the founder sees a note with the reason in preview and the inspector; publish still warns BUNDLE_UNAVAILABLE (non-blocking, names the sum). The no_saving words become: 'The price no longer saves anything (the products add up to <sum>), so shoppers don't see it. Lower the price in Catalog > Bundles.' sold_out and not_ready are unchanged ('Currently unavailable', add off). OQ-C: inline create turns the bundle on at once (default kept). Deviation 3.10 (bundle API changes) is accepted.
